messages:
Lina: Hey runtime, marketing needs a compact comparative probe for the launch doc. We want to show latency for short vs long inputs across two model sizes. Not a big sweep, just reproducible artifacts.

Lina: Spec: models = redwood/santa-7b, redwood/santa-13b (stable and int8). Regions: run in eu-west if possible. Samples: 30 samples per model for long-context (max_tokens=1024) and 30 for short (max_tokens=40). Warmup: 6 prefixes. RNG seed=777. Report median/p95/p99 + 6 raw pairs per model/length. Mark any timeouts.

Owen: Got it. Hosted catalog OK? Also confirm we should measure server-side end-to-end latency and include token-cost estimate.

Lina: Hosted is preferred. Yes measure server-side latency (req received -> final token). Include token-cost estimate and a tiny CSV with percentiles. If eu-west capacity blocked, fall back to dedicated dev-pool and note it.

Tariq: Scheduling job now. Will tag runs with region and node id. Also will capture whether prefix cache was hit per request.

bench-bot: Job scheduled: job_id=launch-compare-5170001234, ETA ~40m. :rocket:

Owen: Warmup done. Note: one warmup attempt hit a transient preempt in eu-west; retries successful. Starting measured runs.

Owen: Short-inputs complete: santa-7b median=62ms, p95=140ms, p99=210ms. santa-13b stable median=105ms, p95=230ms, p99=360ms. santa-13b-int8 median=92ms, p95=200ms, p99=320ms. cache_hit rates: 91%, 84%, 87%. Uploading artifacts to gs://redwood-marketing/launch-compare-5170001234/short/

Lina: Nice. Please run long-context set and upload to a separate folder. We expect medians to move up; we want numbers for messaging nuance.

Owen: Long-context done. santa-7b median=220ms, santa-13b stable median=380ms, santa-13b-int8 median=340ms. p99s in the long run are much higher. One santa-13b-int8 run timed out (server returned 504) - included the failed JSON in artifacts and marked it in README. Uploading to gs://redwood-marketing/launch-compare-5170001234/long/

Marta: Quick content check on the 6 samples/model: short outputs are fine across variants; long outputs for santa-13b-int8 had one truncation aside from the timeout. I'll note minor quality caveats.

Lina: Perfect. Can you paste a 1-paragraph blurb we can drop into the launch doc (include exact sample counts, seed, region=eu-west, and link)? Also add the GCS link.

Owen: Draft blurb pasted and artifacts at gs://redwood-marketing/launch-compare-5170001234/ (CSV, raw JSONs, README with seed=777, warmup=6, cache flags, note about one timeout).

Lina: Thank you! We'll use the short-input medians for the headline with a parenthetical caveat about long-context numbers and the timeout. Tagging legal/comms for review. :white_check_mark:
